sources_read.section: the landing branch and the existing remote reads
teamOfSession / createWorkspace — where an online read belongs
the seven mirrored tables — `sessions` is not one of them

scope: One remote read, the landing list, and its wiring. Out of scope: ordering, rename/delete, search, and any change to RULE-14's redirect-to-last behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: select id, title with no client filter; RLS decides the set.
The list renders above the create form; the heading adapts; the form is untouched.
A click navigates to /w/<id>; a rejection leaves an empty list and no error banner.
verify green; a live list→open; the live suite gains a test that proves the RLS scoping.

open_questions: Whether the pilot wants ordering by recency (needs a column or a local note) and rename/delete; both are product calls.
risks: The list is empty when offline — accepted, because the create form is the offline-capable path and a workspace URL still opens directly.
A sign-in that has not resolved a profile yet must not query; the hook waits for profileId.
Creating a workspace from the same screen still works; the list is additive.
